description: Failed-login logging: the warning logs the whole submitted `user` payload, including the plaintext password, on every failed login.
notes: FM-14 (secrets and sensitive data). The new logger.warning in LoginAPIView.post interpolates the whole `user` dict from the request, which includes the plaintext `password`, so every failed login (often a typo of the user's real password) writes credentials into the log pipeline. Severity important: FM-14 is critical only for an exposed live or production credential; here the exposure needs log access, so it's graded important. It would rise to critical if the logs are shipped to a third party. Fix: log only the email (or a hash of it) and the address, never the payload. The LOGGING config and the unchanged 400 response are legitimate.
